name: RLAB2: the labelled baselines with red-block falls in their failure set, label fixed (RLAB1 repeated with the audit's red-fall rule and a value gate)
why: RLAB1's red label (LSF_LABEL=red) marked a future as failure whenever the red block was tilted >= 45 deg, with no start-eligibility rule (the neighbour label has one) and no 'before extraction' condition (the audit has one): 78 of 99 sampled red-fall-only futures started with the block already flat. The relabelled classifier was negative on 15.2% of the value's start states (original 3.1%); the published-LSF value collapsed (V -1.1 at every episode start), UNISafe-r started at V 0.35 next to its eps 0.30. Neither value was gated before closed loop.
change_vs_RLAB1: label LSF_LABEL=red2 (eval/lsf.py red_fail): a red fall counts only if the future's red block starts upright and resting (tilt < 45 deg, |z - 0.462| <= 1 cm) and only at frames before it is extracted (z +2 cm or x -2 cm from the future's start, sticky), as eval/outcome_audit.py's red-fall-before-extraction rule; futures whose red block starts ineligible keep only the neighbour label (as the neighbour rule treats already-toppled neighbours). Checked on 100 training files: the 'red' path is bit-identical; red-fall-only failures 99 -> 21. Folder results/program_b/lsf_v3_red; tags _rl2*; files rlab2_*. Everything else as RLAB1 (sources, splits, sampling, classifier, both value recipes, dev sweep and rule, test episodes, statistics, H_red, baseline_choice).
value_gate_VG: new, before any closed loop: each relabelled value's V(z, g) on the value's 5969 training start states (eval/rlab1_analysis.py vgate, RLAB=rlab2): pass iff median V >= 0.5 and share V < 0 <= 10% (originals reported next to it). A failing arm is not run in dev or test and is reported as failing VG. Offline classifier report as RLAB1 (descriptive).
hypotheses: as RLAB1: H_red per arm that passes VG (fewer red falls before extraction than its original at 2x, exact McNemar one-sided p < 0.05); also reported per arm vs its original, ours90 and ours80, 2x and 1x, all five outcomes. baseline_choice as RLAB1 (more v4 at 2x wins).
order: S0 data (CPU, now, parallel to GPU jobs) -> waits for the GFX1 chain (which ends after the resumed ABL2 chain) -> classifier -> offline report -> UNISafe value -> LSF-pub value -> VG -> dev (passing arms) -> test (passing arms) -> analysis
